title: Culture
intro: We care deeply about mentorship, team rituals, scientific joy, and building a healthy environment where everyone can do their best work.
culture_text: We are building a lab culture where people feel safe, welcome, and supported, and where excellent science is grounded in respect, kindness, and shared responsibility. We want the lab to be a place where diverse perspectives are valued, ideas are exchanged openly, and people help one another through both the exciting and challenging parts of research. We care deeply about rigorous and thoughtful science, but we also believe that sustainable work habits, collaboration, and a sense of community are essential for people to thrive over the long term.
philosophy_text: Our lab approaches science as a collaborative effort to understand the antigen-specific basis of human disease and to build new ways of studying and redirecting immune recognition. We believe that ambitious, discovery-driven science is strongest when it brings together creativity, rigor, and interdisciplinary thinking. We also see science as a public good and believe researchers have a responsibility to communicate clearly, work with integrity, and contribute to a scientific community that is open, generous, and curious.
mentoring_text: Mentorship is a central part of life in the lab. We are committed to helping each trainee grow into an independent and confident scientist through close scientific guidance, regular feedback, and thoughtful career development conversations. Trainees are encouraged to build technical and analytical skills, strengthen their written and oral communication, and take increasing ownership of their projects over time. Our goal is for lab members to leave with a strong scientific foundation, a clearer sense of where they want to go next, and the support they need to get there.
